items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did have Billy Shaw for a while book my group

ctx.x: Did you have a manager booking you?

Yeah, Willard Alexander booked my group, basically. I did have Billy Shaw for a while book my group, and I had a road manage that was also another story; his name was Milt Gray and he was from Philadelphia. And he was, I could never call him a thief, he wasn’t a thief, but sometimes when we played New York he’d come up with different items from motel lobbies and hotel lobbies and…
